# Local Howl - Client Success Stories
> Case studies showcasing website redesigns, platform migrations, and full rebrands by Local Howl.

## About Local Howl
Local Howl is a local SEO and web design agency that helps local businesses show up on Google, in the Map Pack, and in front of ready-to-book customers. 22 production builds across 10 industries.

## Pages
- [Home](https://success.localhowl.com/) - Index of all client case studies

- [Moore Law Center](https://success.localhowl.com/moore-law-center) - Full rebuild + local SEO: generic criminal-defense site to a credibility-first WordPress/Elementor build with attorney bios, practice-area pages, and county landing pages across metro Atlanta (Marietta, GA)
- [Air Control Services](https://success.localhowl.com/air-control-services) - New build + local SEO: generic template to a fast custom-coded HVAC site with 7 service pages and 20 city pages ranking across Las Cruces and southern New Mexico (Las Cruces, NM)
- [Commercial Electric Motor Service](https://success.localhowl.com/cemsi) - New build + local SEO: aging template to a fast custom-coded electric motor sales and repair site with a photo-to-match motor finder, full category pages, and 6 Metro East city pages for a family-owned shop in business since 1944 (St. Louis, MO)
- [Bryan Lawn Care](https://success.localhowl.com/bryan-lawn-care) - New build + local SEO: fast custom-coded 26-page site with 14 service pages and neighborhood pages for a family-run lawn crew serving Nashville since 2001 with a 4.8-star, 106-review rating (Nashville, TN)
- [Miami Smile Dental](https://success.localhowl.com/miami-smile-dental) - New build + local SEO: boutique multilingual WordPress site with a 106-URL architecture, a Spanish homepage plus ten translated primary pages, and a verified 4.9-star, 233-review Dentist schema (Pinecrest, FL)
- [Penny Window](https://success.localhowl.com/penny-window) - New build + local SEO: Next.js rebuild with 45 style, service, and city URLs, AI-agent-ready lead capture, and the real 4.1-star, 207-review Google rating for a window and door company in business since 1953 (St. Louis, MO)
- [Wraps Redefined](https://success.localhowl.com/wraps-redefined) - New build + local SEO: showroom-dark WordPress build with live Instagram and Google-review feeds, 34 URLs, and a perfect 5.0-star, 93-review rating for a 3M-certified wrap and PPF studio (Dallas, TX)
- [Fixins Roofing & Restoration](https://success.localhowl.com/fixins-roofing) - New build + local SEO: keyword-stuffed Duda template to a fast custom-coded 76-page build with 21 service-area pages, an awards page for nine 2026 Best of the Springs wins, and verified RoofingContractor schema for a veteran-owned contractor (Colorado Springs, CO)
- [Coastal Roofworks](https://success.localhowl.com/coastal-roofworks) - New build + local SEO: stock-photo Scorpion template to a client-editable 66-page WordPress build with English and Spanish pages, 13 service-area pages, and verified RoofingContractor schema carrying a 5.0-star, 31-review rating for a roofing crew serving the Georgia coast since 2006 (Savannah, GA)
- [4 Seasons Landscaping & Construction](https://success.localhowl.com/four-seasons-landscaping) - New build + local SEO: templated site builder to a fast custom-coded 45-page build with dedicated service pages, 11 North Atlanta city pages, and server-rendered LocalBusiness schema carrying a 4.6-star, 105-review rating for a full-service landscaping and hardscape crew serving Atlanta since 2000 (Alpharetta, GA)
